name: Morales (Bolívar, Colombia)
description: Horizontal bicolour of green and blue with a yellow triangle at the hoist extending into a horizontal band, all fimbriated red, the triangle bearing the municipal arms of Morales between palm trees.
history: Municipal flag of Morales, a municipality in the department of Bolívar, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: triangle at the hoist extended by a central band, fimbriated red
fimbriation of the triangle and band
